# slackapp Provider

-> This provider was published as `yumemi-inc/slackapp` up to v0.2.9. To switch, change `source` to `"ymm-oss/slackapp"`, then run `terraform state replace-provider yumemi-inc/slackapp ymm-oss/slackapp` and `terraform init`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `app_configuration_token` (String, Sensitive) App configuration token for the Slack Workspace.
- `base_url` (String) Base URL of the Slack API. Defaults to `https://slack.com/api/`.
- `refresh_token` (String, Sensitive) Refresh token for the Slack Workspace.
